name: 11th World Congress on Women's Mental Health 2027
organizer: International Association for Women's Mental Health
description: The 11th World Congress on Women's Mental Health is organized by the International Association for Women's Mental Health and hosted by the Women and Mental Health working group of the Catalan Society of Psychiatry and Mental Health. The theme is integrating a biopsychosocial approach in women's mental health, with oral presentations, posters, symposia and workshops.
